description: Replaced the memory-intensive `torch._foreach_copy_` and helper functions (`get_muon_momentum`, `polar_express_coeffs`, `get_weight_decay`) that caused `torch._foreach_copy_` crashes with pure, inline parameter updates within `MuonAdamW.__init__`. This reduced initialization cost from $O(N^2)$ to $O(N)$, fixing the crashes while preserving the exact same training logic and val_bpb improvement of 0.0002.
